mean_cn: n.自豪；傲慢；  v.使得意；为……自豪
mean_en: a feeling of pleasure or satisfaction that you get when you or people who are connected with you have done something well or own something that other people admire
sentence: Our manager wants us to take pride in the quality of our work.
sentence_trans: 我们的经理想让我们为自己工作的质量而感到骄傲。
